title: Lead list
description: Accounts that match an ideal customer profile, each checked against the company's own site, and up to two contacts per account by title. Every account and contact names where it came from. Nothing is invented: a company that could not be checked is a near miss, not an account; a contact's name is written as the data returned it.

titles.description: the titles searched for, given or derived

search_filters.description: the filters the company search used

summary.description: how many accounts were found against how many asked for, and why any shortfall

why_it_fits.description: what the company's own site shows, against the ICP criteria

source.description: the URL on the company's own site that shows the fit

found_via.description: the tool or page that surfaced the company (monid:apollo/mixed_companies/search, or a URL)

name.description: as the source gives it, a masked last name included (Keith Bo***n)

source.description: monid:apollo/mixed_people/api_search, or the URL of the company page naming the person

reason.description: the criterion it failed, or why it could not be checked

where.description: a URL fetched, or a tool and its main filter

report_markdown.description: the summary, the accounts table (name, domain, why it fits, source), the contacts table (name, title, company, source), near misses and gaps
